title: Silk Mesh Cuff
descriptionHtml:
Soft to the eye, firm on the wrist. An open cuff built from a rounded tube of fine woven mesh, about 15mm wide, that ends in two mirror-polished oval caps facing each other across the opening. The mesh catches light like brushed silk, so it reads quietly on its own and holds its own beside a watch. In warm gold or bright silver tone.

STYLING TIP: Wear it on the wrist opposite your watch, or pair it with the Mesh Band Ring in the same metal.

Details

  • Style: Open cuff
  • Mesh: Rounded tube of fine woven mesh, approximately 15mm wide
  • Ends: Two mirror polished oval caps facing each other
  • Inner width: Approximately 6cm, with an opening of about 2.5cm
  • Plating: 18k gold tone plated or rhodium plated silver tone (choose above)
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel

Care

Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine. Keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
